owner: Digital Reef / Reef Origin with London Borough of Havering

notes: LDO grants permission for up to 400,000 sqm data centre space on 175-acre Green Belt site at Dunnings Lane/Fen Road, Havering (London borough; site straddles Thurrock boundary). DCD reported 600MW campus concept. Bucketed under Greater London per Havering LPA; round-1 placed under Essex.
